newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline falls with NYMEX, U.S. arb closed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline falls with NYMEX, U.S. arb closed.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker on Monday as NYMEX futures took a tumble, traders said.
A mixed Eurograde/Regular/Superplus barge traded in the morning at $220/$213/$238 fob ARA.
Other Eurograde trades were heard done through the day at $216, $218.50, and $213.

Cargo activity was limited and dealers said falling NYMEX numbers had made arbitrage trade with the United States unworkable. Eurograde cif offers were heard into northern Germany some $3 above the current barge levels.
